died.name: Louis III of France
died.cause: The king of West Francia died aged around 18 at Saint-Denis. While mounting his horse to pursue a girl who was running to seek refuge in her father's house, he hit his head on the lintel of a low door and fell, fracturing his skull.

died.name: Jack Budlong
died.cause: The friend of Errol Flynn was working as an extra on the film They Died with Their Boots On, starring Flynn and Olivia de Havilland. Budlong insisted on using a real saber rather than a prop one. While filming a cavalry charge, Budlong's horse was frightened by the sounds of simulated explosions and threw Budlong, causing him to impale himself with the sword.

died.name: Louis J. Sebille
died.desc: United States Air Force fighter pilot and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: when urged by one of his wingmen to head for an emergency landing strip after being wounded during the Battle of Pusan Perimeter in the Korean War. Sebille then deliberately crashed into a North Korean convoy
died.last_words: No, I'll never make it. I'm going back and get that bastard.

died.name: Victims of the Khamar-Daban incident
died.cause: Six Kazakhstani hikers died in the Khamar-Daban mountain range in Buryatia under uncertain circumstances. According to Valentina Utochenko, the sole survivor of the seven-person hiking group, while descending the mountain, each of the climbers, except her, suffered from a mysterious symptom involving screaming, bleeding from eyes and ears, frothing at the mouth, and clawing at their throat or clothes before dying.

born.name: Joseph Justus Scaliger
born.desc: French Calvinist religious leader and scholar
born.last_words: I begin to perceive and feel the joys of eternal life. I shall soon behold Him, who was sacrificed for men; I long for the blessed sight. All else is to me as dross: there is nothing that could make me wish to live one hour longer.

born.name: John Eliot
born.desc: Puritan missionary to the American Indians, founder of Roxbury Latin School
born.last_words: O, come in glory! I have long waited for Thy coming. Let no dark cloud rest on the work of the Indians. Let it live when I am dead. Welcome joy!

born.name: Ramón María Narváez
born.desc: 1st Duke of Valencia, Spanish general and Prime Minister of Spain
born.last_words: I do not have to forgive my enemies. I have had them all shot.

born.name: Lovisa
born.last_words: I am positioned between Heaven and Earth and feel like I am surrounded by nothing but light. Kiss me one last time! If I have failed in my duties toward you, then forgive me.

born.name: Cyril Rattigan
born.cause: prior to fatally attempting to kill a German sniper during World War I
born.last_words: I'm going to have a shot at getting him in.

born.name: Harold Holt
born.cause: he would subsequently disappear while swimming at Cheviot Beach, Victoria prior to disappearing while swimming at Cheviot Beach
born.last_words: I know this beach like the back of my hand.
